worldcombat.skill.safeguard.summary: Raises a moving ward that protects the user and nearby allies from newly applied harmful conditions. Protection can linger briefly after leaving its range.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.use.0: Block blanket burns, poison and paralysis
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.use.1: Raise the ward before the foe starts spreading conditions
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.use.2: Cover an ally about to step in
The ward lasts %1$s and protects the user and allies within %2$s blocks from new harmful conditions such as burn, poison, paralysis and sleep. Displayed range and duration include the selected ward mode.
The ward does not cure existing conditions or block direct damage, knockback or lowered stat stages. Beneficial effects can still be received.
Raising it takes %1$s, the recovery is %2$s and the cooldown %3$s. See the ward note for the deep/early trade-off.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.ward.0: Early: duration x0.75, radius x0.85, in exchange for -2 ticks wind-up and x0.8 cooldown — quick to raise and refresh.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.ward.1: Deep: duration x1.25, radius x1.15, at +3 ticks wind-up and x1.15 cooldown — held long and spread wide.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.timing: Self-targeted; wind-up %1$s, recovery %2$s, cost %3$s PP, cooldown %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.preference.w: Deep: duration x1.25, radius x1.15, +3 ticks wind-up, x1.15 cooldown — good to hold a position and cover several allies. Early: duration x0.75, radius x0.85, -2 ticks wind-up, x0.8 cooldown — good to keep the whole team covered on the move.
worldcombat.skill.safeguard.preference.a: The partner only considers raising the ward while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for melee pressure, larger prepares from farther away.
Under pressure: only while a foe is attacking the partner or its owner, or the partner was just hurt. Anytime: raise the ward on any threat.
When on, the partner will also leave its post to raise the ward.
world_combat.move.safeguard.text.guard: The ward turns the status away
The ward refreshes nearby allies once per second. When the field ends, allies still inside lose its protection; the user and allies who left early may retain up to about %1$s of residual protection. Clearing the user’s ward ends the field early.
